summary.explanation: Excessive brightness in AR can cause overexposure, reducing contrast and detail, which hampers object recognition and tracking. Users should adjust the exposure settings to balance the scene's in on the shadows to enhance depth perception and improve AR integration.
recommendations: Reduce direct lighting or use diffusers to soften harsh light
Avoid pointing camera directly at bright light sources
Increase ambient lighting or use supplemental light sources
Position light sources to evenly illuminate the scene
